text:
marie: quick heads-up: PR #20988 failing CI on timer-queue-test intermittently. buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/1234#abcde. logs show a timeout in `TimerQueueTest.flush()` (~4s) and a stack trace pointing at the timer thread.

sam: can someone kick a targeted rerun? looks nondet to me.

ci-bot: buildkite: targeted rebuild requested by @sam — job queued (macos-12, linux).

jordan: seeing same on macos-12 pool earlier today, only when TEST_PARALLEL=8. suspect a race in the harness around cancelling timers.

marie: tried to repro locally with `bazel test //service/timers:timer_tests --test_env=TEST_PARALLEL=8` but green on ubuntu. no repro yet.

alex: quick thought: test sometimes relies on real time; adding `await drainTimers()` or making the waits deterministic helped in similar tests. small diff could be safe.

lee: +1 to small change but let's avoid a brittle sleep fix. If we go that route, prefer a fake clock or explicit barrier. also require 3 green reruns before merging.

sam: pinging reviewers @jordan @alex for quick eyes. if targeted reruns are green we can merge tonight — anyone object?

jordan: I'll review the patch in ~20m. if it's just a helper, should be quick.

ci-bot: targeted rerun complete: macos-12 failed again, linux green. build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/1235#def01.

marie: ugh — still flaking on macos. adding extra logs to measure timer delta and thread scheduling. pushing WIP branch `pr/20988-debug-logs`.

alex: if it's scheduling jitter on macOS, fake-clock approach avoids that entirely. can convert test to use `TestClock.freeze()` and advance explicitly. less brittle than sleeps.

marie: agreed — starting a branch converting test to fake clock. will mark as WIP and request re-runs once ready.

sam: sounds good. hold merge until deterministic fix lands. anyone want to pair on fake-clock conversion?

lee: I can pair 11:00am PT tomorrow. good chance we'll rip through it quickly.

marie: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the PR description with the plan and add `hold/merge` label until after the deterministic fix. :thumbsup:
